subject: math
description: Distinguish right and oblique triangles, identify common given cases, and choose an appropriate solution strategy.
learningObjectives: Distinguish right triangles from oblique triangles using angle information
Classify oblique triangles as acute or obtuse
Identify triangle given cases such as SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and SSA
Choose whether a situation calls for right-triangle tools, the Law of Sines, or the Law of Cosines
Explain why the given information is enough or not enough to plan a solution
prerequisites: Basic triangle parts: sides, angles, vertices
Right angle and acute/obtuse angle vocabulary
Basic use of a ruler and protractor
